description.en:
Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Zephyr Stance

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 4.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance

Tekan berulang kali atau tahan Normal Attack untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG dan memulihkan Cloud Breath saat mengenai target.

Mid-air Attack - Zephyr Stance

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG dan memulihkan Cloud Breath saat mengenai target.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Tahap 4.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance

While in Zephyr Stance and Cloud Breath is not full, press Resonance Skill to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore Cloud Breath.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.

Awakening Spring

While in Zephyr Stance and at full Cloud Breath, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Awakening Spring. Casting this skill consumes all Cloud Breath, pulls in nearby targets, and sends Suisui into Drizzle Stance, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting Glacio Chafe on the target 1 time on hit.

Enrichment

Casting Awakening Spring or Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade grants all nearby Resonators in the team 1 stack of Enrichment. This effect can be triggered once every 25s. Incoming Resonators receive healing from Suisui at the cost of Enrichment.

Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance

While in Drizzle Stance, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.
Press Resonance Skill to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore Floral Epistle.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance

Saat dalam Zephyr Stance dan Cloud Breath belum penuh, tekan Resonance Skill agar Suisui menusuk ke depan, memberikan Glacio DMG. Jika Suisui adalah Resonator aktif saat melancarkan skill ini, pulihkan Cloud Breath.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.
Skill ini berbagi Cooldown dengan Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.

Awakening Spring

Saat dalam Zephyr Stance dan Cloud Breath penuh, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance diganti dengan Awakening Spring. Melancarkan skill ini mengonsumsi seluruh Cloud Breath, menarik target di sekitar, dan membawa Suisui ke Drizzle Stance, memberikan Glacio DMG dan memberikan Glacio Chafe pada target sebanyak 1 kali saat mengenai target.

Enrichment

Melancarkan Awakening Spring atau Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade memberikan 1 stack Enrichment kepada seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 25 dtk. Resonator yang masuk menerima penyembuhan dari Suisui dengan mengorbankan Enrichment.

Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance

Saat dalam Drizzle Stance, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance diganti dengan Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.
Tekan Resonance Skill agar Suisui menusuk ke depan, memberikan Glacio DMG. Jika Suisui adalah Resonator aktif saat melancarkan skill ini, pulihkan Floral Epistle.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.
Skill ini berbagi Cooldown dengan Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance.

attributes.name: Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance/Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance Cooldown

description.en:
Casting the skill deploys Ceaseless Landscape that lasts for 30s. When Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui enters the Roaming Transcendent state when casting Outro Skill - Rippling Waters.
Ceaseless Landscape grants all nearby Resonators in the team the following enhancements:
- Inflicting a target with Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, and Aero Erosion, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limit of the corresponding Negative Status the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Inflicting a target with Electro Flare or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limits of Electro Flare and Electro Rage the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Consuming Havoc Bane stacks on the target after landing a skill allows the Resonator's Havoc DMG to ignore the target's DEF by 6% and Havoc RES by 12% for 30s. This effect does not stack.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
description.id:
Melancarkan skill ini menggelar Ceaseless Landscape yang bertahan selama 30 dtk. Saat Ceaseless Landscape aktif, Suisui memasuki kondisi Roaming Transcendent saat melancarkan Outro Skill - Rippling Waters.
Ceaseless Landscape memberikan peningkatan berikut kepada seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim:
- Memberikan Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, dan Aero Erosion pada target, atau memberikan DMG Negative Status yang sesuai, meningkatkan batas stack maksimum Negative Status yang sesuai yang dapat diterima target sebesar 3 selama 15 dtk. Efek ini tidak bertumpuk.
- Memberikan Electro Flare pada target atau memberikan DMG Negative Status yang sesuai meningkatkan batas stack maksimum Electro Flare dan Electro Rage yang dapat diterima target sebesar 3 selama 15 dtk. Efek ini tidak bertumpuk.
- Mengonsumsi stack Havoc Bane pada target setelah skill mengenai sasaran membuat Havoc DMG Resonator mengabaikan 6% DEF target dan 12% Havoc RES target selama 30 dtk. Efek ini tidak bertumpuk.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.

description.en:
Consuming Enrichment grants the Resonator 10 stacks of Spring's Birth, up to 10 stacks. When the Resonator with Spring's Birth is not at full HP, restore their HP by 62 + 0.34% of Suisui's Max HP at the cost of 1 stack of Spring's Birth every 2s.

When Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring and Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade hit a target, they additionally restore 18 points of Concerto Energy and 13 points of Resonance Energy, and increase the attack's Crit. Rate by 80% and Glacio DMG by 240%. This effect can be triggered up to once every 25s.
description.id:
Mengonsumsi Enrichment memberikan 10 stack Spring's Birth kepada Resonator, hingga 10 stack. Saat Resonator dengan Spring's Birth tidak memiliki HP penuh, pulihkan HP mereka sebesar 62 + 0,34% Max HP Suisui dengan mengorbankan 1 stack Spring's Birth setiap 2 dtk.

Saat Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring dan Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade mengenai target, keduanya juga memulihkan 18 poin Concerto Energy dan 13 poin Resonance Energy, serta meningkatkan Crit. Rate serangan sebesar 80% dan Glacio DMG sebesar 240%. Efek ini dapat terpicu paling banyak sekali setiap 25 dtk.

description.en: When a Resonator other than Suisui takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out but will instead regain 50% of Suisui's current HP, while Suisui herself loses the same amount of HP. Suisui's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.
description.id: Saat Resonator selain Suisui menerima serangan fatal, mereka tidak akan tumbang melainkan memulihkan 50% HP Suisui saat ini, sementara Suisui sendiri kehilangan HP dalam jumlah yang sama. HP Suisui tidak akan turun di bawah 1 akibat efek ini. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 menit.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, and inflict Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target.
While casting this skill, consume all Cloud Breath to pull in nearby targets and enter Drizzle Stance.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG, dan memberikan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 1 kali pada target.
Saat melancarkan skill ini, konsumsi seluruh Cloud Breath untuk menarik target di sekitar dan memasuki Drizzle Stance.

description.en:
Zephyr Stance

Suisui is in Zephyr Stance by default. When in Zephyr Stance, Suisui can obtain Cloud Breath through certain skills.

Drizzle Stance

Entering Drizzle Stance clears all Floral Epistle.
During Drizzle Stance:
- Suisui unlocks new combat moves and restores Floral Epistle through certain skills.
-Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
- Press Normal Attack within a certain time after triggering a successful Dodge via Dodge skills to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 1.
After entering Drizzle Stance for 15s, Suisui ends Drizzle Stance and clears all Floral Epistle upon exiting the state.

Dodge - Parting Mist

While performing attacks on the ground, press Dodge to cast Dodge - Parting Mist at the cost of STA.
When in Zephyr Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Cloud Breath. Press Normal Attack shortly after triggering the Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance.
- When in Drizzle Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Floral Epistle, and does not reset the cycle of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance within a certain period.

Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance

When in Drizzle Stance, Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance.
Press Normal Attack repeatedly to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.
When casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 3, continuously pull in nearby targets.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 inflicts Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target on hit.

Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.

Illuminating Dew

When in Drizzle Stance, keep holding Normal Attack after casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Swallow's Cut

When in Drizzle Stance, cast this skill in one of the following ways:
- Release the Normal Attack button while casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance.
- Press Normal Attack while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Cloud Breath

Max 120 points.
When in Zephyr Stance:
- Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance and Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance restore Cloud Breath on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance restores 40 points of Cloud Breath when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 35 points of Cloud Breath.

Floral Epistle

Max 600 points.
When in Drizzle Stance:
- Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance restore Floral Epistle on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance restores 100 points of Floral Epistle when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 102 points of Floral Epistle.
description.id:
Zephyr Stance

Suisui berada dalam Zephyr Stance secara default. Saat dalam Zephyr Stance, Suisui dapat memperoleh Cloud Breath melalui skill tertentu.

Drizzle Stance

Memasuki Drizzle Stance menghapus seluruh Floral Epistle.
Selama Drizzle Stance:
- Suisui membuka gerakan tempur baru dan memulihkan Floral Epistle melalui skill tertentu.
-Suisui mendapat ketahanan lebih tinggi terhadap interupsi.
- Tekan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah memicu Dodge berhasil melalui skill Dodge untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Tahap 1.
Setelah memasuki Drizzle Stance selama 15 dtk, Suisui mengakhiri Drizzle Stance dan menghapus seluruh Floral Epistle saat keluar dari kondisi tersebut.

Dodge - Parting Mist

Saat melakukan serangan di darat, tekan Dodge untuk melancarkan Dodge - Parting Mist dengan mengorbankan STA.
Saat dalam Zephyr Stance, memicu Dodge berhasil saat melancarkan Dodge - Parting Mist memulihkan Cloud Breath. Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah memicu Dodge untuk melancarkan Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance.
- Saat dalam Drizzle Stance, memicu Dodge berhasil saat melancarkan Dodge - Parting Mist memulihkan Floral Epistle, dan tidak mengatur ulang siklus Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance dalam jangka waktu tertentu.

Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance

Saat dalam Drizzle Stance, Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance diganti dengan Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance.
Tekan Normal Attack berulang kali untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG dan memulihkan Floral Epistle saat mengenai target.
Saat melancarkan Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Tahap 3, terus tarik target di sekitar.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Tahap 4 memberikan Glacio Chafe sebanyak 1 kali pada target saat mengenai target.

Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG dan memulihkan Floral Epistle saat mengenai target.

Illuminating Dew

Saat dalam Drizzle Stance, terus tahan Normal Attack setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance untuk melancarkan skill ini.
Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Swallow's Cut

Saat dalam Drizzle Stance, lancarkan skill ini dengan salah satu cara berikut:
- Lepas tombol Normal Attack saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance.
- Tekan Normal Attack saat Suisui berada di udara.
Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Cloud Breath

Maks. 120 poin.
Saat dalam Zephyr Stance:
- Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance dan Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance memulihkan Cloud Breath saat mengenai target.
- Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance memulihkan 40 poin Cloud Breath saat Suisui adalah Resonator aktif di tim.
- Memicu Dodge berhasil saat melancarkan Dodge - Parting Mist memulihkan 35 poin Cloud Breath.

Floral Epistle

Maks. 600 poin.
Saat dalam Drizzle Stance:
- Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance dan Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance memulihkan Floral Epistle saat mengenai target.
- Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance memulihkan 100 poin Floral Epistle saat Suisui adalah Resonator aktif di tim.
- Memicu Dodge berhasil saat melancarkan Dodge - Parting Mist memulihkan 102 poin Floral Epistle.

description.en:
Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent when Ceaseless Landscape is active.
Suisui exits Drizzle Stance and consumes all Floral Epistle and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed:

0 Floral Epistle consumed:
- All nearby Resonators in the team gain Reflecting Shadows for 6s. Resonators with Reflecting Shadows have increased resistance to interruption.

At least 200 Floral Epistle consumed:
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform Plume Step for the first time within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 400 Floral Epistle consumed:
- During this Roaming Transcendent state, the active Resonator within the Ceaseless Landscape deals more DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator deals 0.2% more DMG, up to 12%.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the second Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 600 Floral Epistle consumed:
- When Suisui performs the first Plume Step, all nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape gain the following effects for the duration of this Roaming Transcendent:
- When they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When Resonators with Undulating Mist consume Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's ATK is increased by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When Undulating Mist is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the third Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

Roaming Transcendent

Lasts for 30s.
During Roaming Transcendent, Suisui will merge with Ceaseless Landscape and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform Plume Steps at intervals based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed when Outro Skill - Rippling Waters is cast.
When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.
When Ceaseless Landscape isn't active, she will exit the Roaming Transcendent state.

Plume Step

Performing Plume Step grants Reflecting Shadows to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within the Ceaseless Landscape, and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape.
description.id:
Resonator di tim mendapat Amplify All DMG sebesar 25% selama 30 dtk.

Suisui memasuki Roaming Transcendent saat Ceaseless Landscape aktif.
Suisui keluar dari Drizzle Stance, mengonsumsi seluruh Floral Epistle, dan membuka efek berikut berdasarkan jumlah Floral Epistle yang dikonsumsi:

0 Floral Epistle dikonsumsi:
- Seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim mendapat Reflecting Shadows selama 6 dtk. Resonator dengan Reflecting Shadows memiliki ketahanan lebih tinggi terhadap interupsi.

Minimal 200 Floral Epistle dikonsumsi:
- Jika Ceaseless Landscape aktif, Suisui dapat melakukan Plume Step pertama dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah memulai Transcendent Dance saat dalam Roaming Transcendent.

Minimal 400 Floral Epistle dikonsumsi:
- Selama kondisi Roaming Transcendent ini, Resonator aktif di dalam Ceaseless Landscape memberikan lebih banyak DMG jika memiliki Reflecting Shadows. Untuk setiap 1% Energy Regen Suisui di atas 200%, Resonator memberikan 0,2% lebih banyak DMG, hingga maksimal 12%.
- Jika Ceaseless Landscape aktif, Suisui dapat melakukan Plume Step kedua dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah memulai Transcendent Dance saat dalam Roaming Transcendent.

Minimal 600 Floral Epistle dikonsumsi:
- Saat Suisui melakukan Plume Step pertama, seluruh Resonator aktif di sekitar dalam tim yang berada di dalam Ceaseless Landscape mendapat efek berikut selama durasi Roaming Transcendent ini:
- Saat mereka melancarkan Outro Skill, Suisui memberikan Undulating Mist kepada Resonator yang masuk. Saat Resonator dengan Undulating Mist mengonsumsi stack Negative Status atau Electro Rage pada target, mereka mendapat peningkatan ATK: Untuk setiap 0,12% Energy Regen Suisui di atas 200%, ATK Resonator meningkat sebesar 0,1% selama 6 dtk, hingga maksimal 50%. Undulating Mist bertahan selama 14 dtk atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar lapangan. Saat Undulating Mist dihapus, efek peningkatan ATK juga dihapus.
- Jika Ceaseless Landscape aktif, Suisui dapat melakukan Plume Step ketiga dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah memulai Transcendent Dance saat dalam Roaming Transcendent.

Roaming Transcendent

Bertahan selama 30 dtk.
Selama Roaming Transcendent, Suisui akan menyatu dengan Ceaseless Landscape dan memulai Transcendent Dance, yang selama itu ia akan melakukan Plume Step dengan interval berdasarkan jumlah Floral Epistle yang dikonsumsi saat Outro Skill - Rippling Waters dilancarkan.
Saat Suisui adalah Resonator aktif di tim, ia menghentikan Transcendent Dance.
Saat Ceaseless Landscape tidak aktif, ia akan keluar dari kondisi Roaming Transcendent.

Plume Step

Melakukan Plume Step memberikan Reflecting Shadows kepada seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim selama 6 dtk, memberikan 1 stack Glacio Chafe kepada seluruh musuh di dalam Ceaseless Landscape, dan menyembuhkan Resonator aktif di sekitar dalam tim yang berada di dalam Ceaseless Landscape.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
Resonators with Undulating Mist also gain ATK increase after inflicting Negative Status or dealing Negative Status DMG.
The duration of Reflecting Shadows obtained through the third Plume Step is extended by 100%.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance, Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance, Plunging Attack - Illuminating Dew and Plunging Attack - Swallow's Cut are immune to interruption.
description.id:
Resonator dengan Undulating Mist juga mendapat peningkatan ATK setelah memberikan Negative Status atau memberikan DMG Negative Status.
Durasi Reflecting Shadows yang diperoleh melalui Plume Step ketiga diperpanjang sebesar 100%.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance, Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance, Plunging Attack - Illuminating Dew dan Plunging Attack - Swallow's Cut kebal terhadap interupsi.

description.en:
All nearby Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape have their Crit. DMG increased by 50% for 30s after performing the following actions:
- Inflicting Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, Aero Erosion, and Electro Flare, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG.
- Consuming Havoc Bane stacks on the target.
When the active Resonator is not in the Ceaseless Landscape, this Crit. DMG bonus effect is disabled.
description.id:
Seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim yang berada di dalam Ceaseless Landscape mendapat peningkatan Crit. DMG sebesar 50% selama 30 dtk setelah melakukan tindakan berikut:
- Memberikan Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, Aero Erosion, dan Electro Flare, atau memberikan DMG Negative Status yang sesuai.
- Mengonsumsi stack Havoc Bane pada target.
Saat Resonator aktif tidak berada di dalam Ceaseless Landscape, efek Crit. DMG bonus ini dinonaktifkan.

description.en:
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4.

Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance grants Kingfisher. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect. Casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 consumes Kingfisher to restore 20 points of Concerto Energy and 350 points of Floral Epistle. Kingfisher can be consumed up to once every 25s.
description.id:
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Tahap 4.

Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance memberikan Kingfisher. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek ini. Melancarkan Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Tahap 4 mengonsumsi Kingfisher untuk memulihkan 20 poin Concerto Energy dan 350 poin Floral Epistle. Kingfisher dapat dikonsumsi paling banyak sekali setiap 25 dtk.

description.en: Healing provided by Enrichment and Spring's Birth are increased by 50%.
description.id: Penyembuhan dari Enrichment dan Spring's Birth meningkat sebesar 50%.

description.en: The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance are increased by 100%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance dan Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance meningkat sebesar 100%.

description.en: The Crit. DMG of Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade and Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring is increased by 500%.
